policy.ordinaryImport: SnapshotCodec.decodeImport and HabitController.importJson remain strict: nonblank title at most 80 UTF-16 code units, note at most 2000.
policy.syncIncoming: Authenticated incoming h/title and n/text continue to use the same strict validators before shadow/cursor persistence; no compatibility option.
policy.backupRestore: All existing file (JSON, plaintext envelope, encrypted HGB), pasted JSON and WebDAV restore entry points use BackupPreview.forRestore. Otherwise-valid compatible snapshots report oversized text counts and maximum lengths. The existing restore dialog defaults the preserve-history checkbox to false and disables confirmation until explicitly selected.
policy.exceptionBoundary: Only supported legacy text lengths are exempted during explicitly chosen restoreCompatibleBackup. Shared decode retains its title <=1000 and whole-file size/structure/date/ID/version rules; cryptographic authentication remains unchanged. No text is trimmed or truncated.
policy.versionMetadata: JSON version and manifest metadata are not automatic permission or proof of old content. A migrated version-7 snapshot may also contain legacy text.
policy.transaction: Ordinary import and compatible restore share _replaceImportedSnapshot and the existing replace transaction: protect original data, restore as a new local vault, preserve source vault, roll back on failure. Subsequent editing uses current text limits.
policy.designReconciliation: Ordinary input/import fulfills product-planning line 44; explicitly confirmed compatible restore preserves the independent-backup/full-restore promises in product F08, version-upgrade line 76 and data/sync lines 65/75.
